BrochureContent.Content:
Horan Estates are pleased to present 7 Silloge Gardens to the market — a well-maintained three-bedroom mid-terrace family home set in a quiet and established part of Ballymun, Dublin 11. The property enjoys a particularly pleasant aspect, sitting directly opposite a large open green which gives the home a bright and open outlook to the front.

The accommodation is well proportioned throughout and offers generous living space across two floors. On the ground floor, a welcoming entrance hall leads to a bright living room with a feature fireplace to the front, and a large, well-fitted kitchen to the rear with solid timber units, granite-style worktops, a red tile splashback and French doors opening to the rear garden. A downstairs WC off the hall adds a practical touch. Upstairs, three well-proportioned bedrooms are served by a family bathroom with a full bath and electric shower. Two storage closets on the landing provide useful additional storage. The rear garden is private and well presented, with a patio area, lawn and garden shed.

The location offers excellent everyday convenience. Silloge Gardens is within easy reach of a wide range of local shops, schools, parks and leisure facilities, with Charlestown Shopping Centre, IKEA and Omni Park Shopping Centre all just a short drive away. The M1 and M50 motorways are easily accessible, placing Dublin Airport and the city centre within approximately 15 minutes by car. The area is also well served by Dublin Bus with regular routes into the city centre.

This is a fine family home in a well-connected north Dublin location.

Local schools include Holy Spirit Boys National School and St. Joseph's Secondary School

Dublin Airport — approximately 10–15 minutes by car via the M1
M50 and M1 motorways — both easily accessible, ideal for commuters
Dublin City Centre — approximately 20 minutes by car


Early viewing is highly recommended.
